name: Archana Sawant
conditions: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. Patient reports exertional dyspnea, orthopnea, and fatigue. On examination: bilateral basal crackles, elevated JVP, pitting edema up to mid‑calf. Spirometry: FEV1 1.85 L (68% predicted), FVC 2.30 L (78%), FEV1/FVC 0.80; unchanged from prior. Asthma Control Test 22 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Smoking status: never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg BD
Bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD
Spironolactone 25 mg OD
Furosemide 40 mg OD
Dapagliflozin 10 mg OD
Cetirizine 10 mg HS
Fluticasone nasal spray 1 spray each nostril OD
Montelukast 10 mg HS
Cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Allergic rhinitis – sensitivity to house dust mite and pollen. Symptoms: sneezing, nasal congestion, clear rhinorrhea. No asthma exacerbation.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: EF 38% (echo), NYHA class II. Serum potassium 4.2 mmol/L (3.5‑5.0). Serum creatinine 112 µmol/L (60‑110). NT‑proBNP 620 pg/mL (<300). Total serum IgE 210 IU/mL (<100). Serum 25‑OH vitamin D 14 ng/mL (30‑100). Serum calcium 9.1 mg/dL (8.5‑10.5). Serum phosphate 3.4 mg/dL (2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. Improved dyspnea on exertion, no orthopnea. Exam: mild basal crackles, JVP normal, trace edema. Spirometry: FEV1 1.92 L (70% predicted) ↑0.07 L, FVC 2.35 L (80%), FEV1/FVC 0.82. ACT 23 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Smoking: never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Furosemide increased to 60 mg OD
All other meds unchanged.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: EF 40% (echo), NYHA II. K+ 4.6 mmol/L. Creatinine 108 µmol/L. NT‑proBNP 540 pg/mL. Vitamin D 28 ng/mL (after loading). Calcium 9.2 mg/dL. Phosphate 3.5 mg/dL. IgE 190 IU/mL.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. Stable, reports occasional night‑time cough. Exam: clear lungs, no JVP elevation, no edema. Spirometry: FEV1 1.88 L (69%) ↓0.04 L, FVC 2.30 L (79%), FEV1/FVC 0.82. ACT 21 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Smoking: never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Cholecalciferol switched to maintenance 1000 IU OD
All other meds unchanged.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Transthoracic echocardiogram: LVEF 42%, mild diastolic dysfunction, no significant valve disease. LV dimensions normal. Inferior vena cava collapsible >50% with sniff.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. Patient feels more energetic, denies dyspnea. Exam: lungs clear, JVP normal, no edema. Spirometry: FEV1 2.00 L (73%) ↑0.12 L, FVC 2.38 L (82%), FEV1/FVC 0.84. ACT 24 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Smoking: never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Bisoprolol increased to 5 mg OD
All other meds unchanged.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: EF 44% (echo), NYHA I. K+ 5.3 mmol/L (slightly high). Creatinine 115 µmol/L. NT‑proBNP 480 pg/mL. Vitamin D 32 ng/mL. Calcium 9.3 mg/dL. Phosphate 3.6 mg/dL.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. Noted mild fatigue, no dyspnea. Exam: lungs clear, JVP normal, trace ankle edema. Spirometry: FEV1 1.95 L (71%) ↓0.05 L, FVC 2.35 L (81%), FEV1/FVC 0.83. ACT 20 (borderline well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Smoking: never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Spironolactone stopped due to K+ 5.3 mmol/L
Furosemide reduced to 40 mg OD
All other meds unchanged.
